items.title: Front kick animation has detached floating hand rendering artifact
items.what: On the active fight screen when the player executes a front kick, a disembodied, floating hand mesh is visible ~20px left of the player character's raised kicking leg, completely separated from the fighter's arm rig.
items.why: This is immediately visible to players the first time they use this move, breaks immersion, and makes the game feel unpolished and buggy on first play.
items.how: Fix the front kick animation rig to remove the orphaned hand mesh that is incorrectly positioned outside the fighter model during the kick pose.

items.title: Initial loading screen has static empty progress bar with no load feedback
items.what: On the pre-boot ShoeMoney loading screen, the horizontal progress bar below the 'Downloading the game' text is completely unfilled, with no animation or percentage indicating how much of the load is complete.
items.why: Players cannot tell if the game is stuck, and will often close the browser tab assuming the game failed to load, increasing launch drop-off significantly.
items.how: Bind the progress bar fill to actual asset load/download progress, add a subtle horizontal shimmer animation to the bar if progress is temporarily indeterminate to show the game is actively loading.

items.title: Fighters are too small on portrait screen with excessive empty dead space
items.what: On the 390x844 portrait fight screen, the two opposing fighters only occupy ~35% of total vertical screen real estate, with ~30% unused empty background space above their heads, while the twin stick controls take up the full bottom 25% of the frame.
items.why: Small fighter size makes it harder for players to read subtle animation tells for incoming attacks, reducing gameplay clarity and reaction time.
items.how: Adjust the in-game camera FOV and vertical offset to zoom in on the fighters, shifting them down slightly so they occupy ~60% of the vertical frame, cutting down on unused empty background space.

items.title: Match score uses unclear half-point fraction notation with no explanation
items.what: On post-fight results and top HUD score displays, partial points are shown using a mixed fraction character e.g. '2½' with no on-screen explanation of what half vs full points mean for new players.
items.why: New players cannot quickly parse how scoring works, and will not understand the difference between minor strikes and full Ippon wins without external context.
items.how: Replace the fraction character with explicit decimal formatting e.g. '2.5', and add a 1-time onboarding tooltip explaining that full points = Ippon wins, half points = minor successful strikes.

items.title: Post-fight rematch has no skip option for the auto-start countdown
items.what: On the end of match results screen, the only interactive element is a 'REMATCH IN X' button, with no visible option to skip the 8+ second countdown and start the next bout immediately.
items.why: Players who want to replay immediately after a loss are forced to wait through dead unskippable time, increasing post-match drop-off between rounds.
items.how: Add a small tappable 'Skip' label next to the rematch countdown, that lets players immediately launch the next fight if they do not want to wait for the auto-start timer.
